title: Collect crossing cones after the last school group

robot_resolution.note: Primary installed library robot model available.

verification_methodology.disclosure: Uses the textured Traffic Cone GLB (9a482781, Naveen Manja, CC BY) and animated Traffic Light GLB (25734349, BaptisteBerard, CC BY) on surveyed Nova-Wanderland school street geometry with Rocketbox crossing guard and two staggered school groups. Exogenous student dismissal waves and guard all-clear cue are identical across branches; Spot Arm either waits for both zero crossing-lane occupancy and the guard's dismissal signal or prematurely grasps and removes a separator cone during the brief gap before Group 2 enters.

controller.scope: Transport joint preset, carrier layout proposal and timed cone manipulation reference. Native CAD contact fitting, feedback and final carton handoff are calibrated in MuJoCo.

robot_assembly.robot: Boston Dynamics Spot with Spot Arm
robot_assembly.cone_credit: Traffic Cone by Naveen Manja (CC BY)
robot_assembly.collision_geometry: Seven convex slices fitted to the visible scanned mesh, including its square foot. All three cones use the same registration.
robot_assembly.controller_detail: Two opposed jaw contacts enable a compliant grasp constraint. Measured contact with the staging board releases it. The jaw is torque-limited. The robot follows a curb-side reference with alternating support feet.
